}

}

# Country scope. Inoculation (S5, doc 84): Medicine II, the cure known, not inoculated yet, and its price.
DA_ILL_can_inoculate_1 = {
	DA_completed.Medicine_2 = yes
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ILL_cure_known_tt
		has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Marsh_Fever
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ILL_not_inoculated_tt
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_ILL_inoculated.Marsh_Fever }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Cold_Chains }
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 5 }
		treasury = 50
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Cold_Chains } }
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 10 }
		treasury = 100
	}
}

		has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Seven_Deadly_Sins
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ILL_not_inoculated_tt
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_ILL_inoculated.Seven_Deadly_Sins }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Cold_Chains }
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 5 }
		treasury = 50
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Cold_Chains } }
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 10 }
		treasury = 100
	}
}

# Province scope (the province view, FROM the viewer). A company of Plague Doctors can be hired here.
DA_ILL_can_hire_doctors = {
	owner = {
		DA_completed.Medicine_3 = yes
		treasury = 50
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = DA_ILL_doctors_free_tt
			NOT = { num_of_owned_provinces_with = { value = 3 has_province_modifier = DA_ILL_plague_doctors } }
		}
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ILL_doctors_not_here_tt
		NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_ILL_plague_doctors }
	}
}

# The owner can quarantine it: Medicine I, and the province is sick or next to a sick one (a cordon).
DA_ILL_can_quarantine = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ILL_can_quarantine_tt
		owner = { DA_completed.Medicine_1 = yes }
		NOT = { DA_ILL_is_quarantined = yes }
		OR = {
			DA_has_disease_in_province = yes
			any_neighbor_province = { DA_has_disease_in_province = yes }
		}
	}
}

DA_ILL_can_burn = {
	DA_has_disease_in_province = yes
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Medicine.Burning_province }
}

# The owner knows the cure of the province's illness and its treasury pays for it.
DA_ILL_can_cure = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ILL_can_cure_tt
		OR = {
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Marsh_Fever treasury = 30 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Red_Cough treasury = 20 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Flu owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Flu treasury = 30 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Gutrot owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Gutrot treasury = 30 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Duskwither_Plague owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Duskwither_Plague treasury = 50 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Silent_Pox owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Silent_Pox treasury = 50 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Redblight owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Redblight treasury = 40 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Chulklung owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Chulklung treasury = 50 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Overload owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Mana_Overload treasury = 60 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Corruption owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Mana_Corruption treasury = 70 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Metallic_Corrosion owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Metallic_Corrosion treasury = 60 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Soulblight owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Soulblight treasury = 50 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Dreams_of_Reality owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Dreams_of_Reality treasury = 90 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Godscar owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Godscar treasury = 70 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Thorns owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.White_Thorns treasury = 90 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Seven_Deadly_Sins owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Seven_Deadly_Sins treasury = 90 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Bender_of_Will treasury = 80 } }
			AND = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence owner = { has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.White_Pestilence treasury = 100 } }
		}
	}
}

DA_ILL_foodborne = {
	OR = {
		has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever
		has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Gutrot
		has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Redblight
	}
}
